title: Contract Risk Review, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Contract Risk Review workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 1 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Meridian Healthcare (UpcomingRenewalId CTR-5002), with RenewalDate 2027-09-15.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Contract Risk Review Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 1 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Legal Operations Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which agreements should I put in front of counsel first, and what is driving the priority?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: NovaTech Systems; Atlas Financial Group; Review support only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Commercial Attorney
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Walk me through the liability, IP ownership, and payment-term language that needs attention in the MSA.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Liability Cap; IP Ownership; Payment Terms. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Legal Operations Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Compare the available contract evidence with our internal policy and tell me where the file is incomplete.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Internal Policy Requirements; REVIEW REQUIRED; CTR-5002. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: General Counsel
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare the negotiation positions, fallbacks, and escalation points for the highest-risk agreements.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Non-Negotiable Amendments; General Counsel; Draft positions. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Contract Risk Review: 1 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Meridian Healthcare (UpcomingRenewalId CTR-5002), with RenewalDate 2027-09-15.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload upcoming-renewals.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set UpcomingRenewalId, RenewalDate, DaysOut, ExactAction to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Meridian Healthcare (UpcomingRenewalId CTR-5002), with RenewalDate 2027-09-15.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Contract Risk Review Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Contract Risk Review Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the one list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_contract-risk-policy-playbook.md, aibast_contract-risk-synthetic-agreements.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the upcoming renewals tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals; name the tool Get upcoming renewal records.
steps.expected: Get upcoming renewal records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 1 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 1 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: NovaTech Systems; Atlas Financial Group; Review support only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Non-Negotiable Amendments; General Counsel; Draft positions. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: contract-risk-review-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 1 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Contract Risk Review Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 1 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Contract Risk Review Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Contract Risk Review Upcoming Renewals tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Meridian Healthcare (UpcomingRenewalId CTR-5002), with RenewalDate 2027-09-15.
